title: Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards: government response to report
description: The government's response to the Committee's 2020 report Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards
summary: The government has issued a statement in response to a report on artificial intelligence and public standards. The response aims to address the recommendations made in the report, outlining the government's plans for regulating AI in the public sector.

title: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) in education
description: The Department for Education’s (DfE) position on the use of generative AI in the education sector.
summary: The Department for Education has a position on the use of generative AI in schools, but I don't have enough information to provide a more detailed summary.

title: ​​Ofqual’s approach to regulating the use of artificial intelligence in the qualifications sector​
description: Published in response to a request from the Secretary of State for Education, the Secretary of State for Science, Innovation and Technology, and the Secretary of State for Business and Trade.
summary: Ofqual is creating an approach to regulate the use of artificial intelligence in qualifications. This policy was developed in response to requests from UK government ministers in education, science, and business departments.

title: Report and impact assessment on Copyright and Artificial Intelligence
description: A report and impact assessment on the use of copyright works in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) systems.
summary: This report examines how copyright laws affect the use of creative works in artificial intelligence systems. It provides an assessment of the impact of copyright on AI development.

title: Government response to the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence
description: Government response to the Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence report ‘AI in the UK: No Room for Complacency’.
summary: The UK government has responded to a report by the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence, highlighting the importance of addressing the challenges and opportunities presented by AI in the country. The response aims to outline the government's plans to regulate and develop AI responsibly, following the committee's recommendations.

title: AI and Public Standards – Terms of Reference
description: Terms of Reference and FAQs for the Committee's review into artificial intelligence and public standards.
summary: The document provides terms of reference and frequently asked questions for a committee reviewing the impact of artificial intelligence on public standards. The purpose of this review is to assess and advise on the alignment of current and future standards with the development of artificial intelligence.

title: CSPL submission to Science and Technology Committee inquiry on Governance of AI
description: CSPL has submitted written evidence to the Science and Technology Committee's inquiry on Governance of Artificial Intelligence.
summary: The UK Cabinet Secretary's Power and Liaison (CSPL) has provided input to a parliamentary inquiry on how Artificial Intelligence (AI) should be governed. The submission aims to inform discussion on the governance of AI within the UK.

title: Impact of AI on the regulation of medical products
description: Implementing the Artificial Intelligence (AI) White Paper principles.
summary: This policy document focuses on how the increasing use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) will affect the process of regulating medical products. It appears to be implementing the recommendations from the AI White Paper to address these changes.

title: Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy
description: Our vision is that, in terms of AI, we will be the world’s most effective, efficient, trusted and influential Defence organisation for our size.
summary: The Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy aims to make the organization the most effective, efficient, trusted, and influential in the world for its size when it comes to AI. It sets a vision for the organization's AI capabilities.

title: Transport artificial intelligence action plan
description: Sets out how DfT will work with the transport sector to exploit the opportunities from AI while managing potential risks.
summary: This document outlines a plan by the Department for Transport to harness the benefits of artificial intelligence in the transport sector while minimizing potential risks. It aims to collaborate with the transport industry to fully utilize AI technology.
